payload.title: Article bodies show the Night image when Light is picked by hand on a dark system
payload.description: In src/papyrus_content/markus_renderer/images.py DARK_VARIANT_CSS, the dark rule is :root:not([data-theme]):not(.dark) inside a prefers-color-scheme dark media query. The app's hand-picked Light sets class light / light-theme (no data-theme, no dark class), so on a dark system the media rule still hides the Day image and shows Night. Fix: also exclude :root.light, :root.light-theme and [data-theme=light], as the card CSS in markus-components.css does. Found while doing PPY-7d34fa.
